initialExam.title: ITBP Constable 2026 (Indo-Tibetan Border Police)
initialExam.description: ITBP Constable GD recruitment for border guarding duties along the India-China border. One of India's Central Armed Police Forces under MHA.
initialExam.syllabus: GK, GS, Mathematics, Analytical Aptitude, Reasoning, English/Hindi.
initialExam.examPattern: Written: 100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours. PET. Medical. Trade Test.
initialExam.selectionProcess: PST/PET → Written Test → Medical → Document Verification → Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Constable GD in ITBP for border security duty
initialExam.careerGrowth: Constable → Head Constable → ASI → SI → Inspector → AC → DC → Commandant.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Ration Money, Medical, Risk/Hardship allowance, Pension, Free quarters
